title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-28
lineage: Uher mic > Uher 4000 Report L 5in reels > MacIntosh pre-amp > TEAC 1230 7in reel

ai_review.summary: Fair audience tape of a high‑energy 1970s show that captures the historic crowd vibe despite primitive recording quality.
ai_review.review: The performance is remembered by many reviewers as a memorable, marathon concert with an enthusiastic massive audience, though some note it felt insipid at times. The source is an audience recording made on cheap equipment – not crisp like a soundboard but surprisingly listenable for its era. Overall the tape offers a valuable historical snapshot even if the audio fidelity is only fair.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality receives mostly positive remarks (high energy, memorable) while recording quality is described as mediocre to surprisingly good; weighted average yields a ~3.7‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recorded on a cheap tape deck with noticeable muffiness and limited clarity, but retains crowd ambience and enough detail to follow the music.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewers focus on overall marathon nature of the concert.
